comment: The cases of the plateau model (run 0077, wave 014, W-3): the header key `plateau`, the manifest of kind `plateau` with its patches, the tree of the plateaus, and the references declared once in a chain. PlateauModelTest.java (command line) and plateau-model.test.js (editor) read this file; add a case here and both run it. `settings`: the text of workspace.yaml (`settings: {}` when absent; `manifests/` is read). `files`: a path from the folder of workspace.yaml -> the text of the file. `expect.loaded`: the references of the application layer that are drawn (nothing but the plateau baseline is drawn until the plateaus are loaded as layers, W-4); `expect.warnings`: the warnings, without `warning: ` (checked when the workspace loads: a load that stops says its mistakes and no warning); `expect.errors`: the mistakes of the tree and of the references (the command line prints one `error:` line for each; the editor lists them in the model of the plateaus); `expect.fileError`: a manifest the reader refuses (`file`, the `sentence`, and the `where` the command line adds when it reads the file itself: ` (line L, column C)`); `expect.settingsConflict`: the load stops (the editor says `Could not read the plateaus of workspace.yaml:` before it).

cases.what: a manifest of any kind accepts plateau: in its header (an element of each layer, a view, a story); the plateau exists through the header, and only the manifests of baseline are drawn until the layers are loaded
